title: skillevaluation test run result
description: Run-level aggregate emitted by a conforming runner after all cases complete.

with_skill.description: Fraction in [0,1] — passed cases / aggregated cases. NULL when cases_aggregated == 0 (nothing was measured); never fabricate 0.

delta_pts.description: Pass-rate delta in percentage POINTS, not percent. (with - without) * 100. NULL when cases_aggregated == 0 — the run measured nothing, so report N/A rather than a fabricated 0.

errors.description: Number of cases excluded due to error outcome.

error_dominated.description: True when errored cases / total_cases > 0.25 (the error-dominated floor) — the run is not a valid measurement: pass_rate.delta_pts is NULL (the headline claim is withheld) and the run verdict is `error`. Disclosure counts stay populated.

cases_aggregated.description: Number of cases that contributed to aggregate metrics.

cases_skipped_apples_oranges.description: Number of cases excluded by the apples-to-oranges skip rule.

total_cases.description: Total number of cases in the suite.

cases_correctness_gated.description: Cases where BOTH arms passed — the divisor for the *_correctness_gated efficiency deltas.

cases_skipped_trigger_only.description: Trigger-only cases (should_trigger with no grader, spec 0.3.0) the A/B loop skipped with disclosure. They never enter total_cases or the lift divisor. Omitted by runners that predate trigger cases.

verdict.description: Coarse run-level verdict; derived from per-case outcomes.

runs.description: Uniform i.i.d. re-runs per case this run executed (runner-level, schema rev 2). Rates are MEANS over all (case, run) records; omitted when 1.

delta_pct.description: Signed percentage delta. NULL when without_skill_avg == 0 — never fabricate a value.
